standards.name: REMBI: Recommended Metadata for Biological Images
standards.abstract: REMBI describes recommended metadata for biological imaging experiments (light, electron and X‑ray microscopy and related modalities). It covers study- and dataset-level information, biosamples and specimens, image acquisition and instrument parameters, image data properties (formats, dimensions, pixel sizes), image correlation information and analysed data. The guideline is intended to support archiving and reuse of raw and processed microscopy images and associated derived data across diverse imaging communities.

classification.rationale: REMBI is represented as a structured set of modules and attributes (a metadata table) in the Supplementary Figure 1 (modules and attributes), describing fields to capture for studies, biosamples, specimens, acquisition, image data, correlation and analysis. This is a metadata table-style standard rather than a set of abstract principles or a workflow DAG.
